They met at a garden party.

senses.title: Edible bulb

intro.en: Garlic is an Old English compound that describes a spear-shaped leek.
intro.cn: garlic 是古英语复合词，描述形状像矛的韭葱。

items.en: Garleac joined gar, meaning spear, and leac, meaning leek.
items.cn: garleac 由意为矛的 gar 和意为韭葱的 leac 组成。

items.en: The name described a plant with spear-shaped leaves.
items.cn: 这个名字描述叶片形似长矛的植物。

items.en: The spelling settled as garlic.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 garlic。

items.en: It became a common kitchen seasoning.
items.cn: 它成为常见的厨房调料。

items.en: The word also came to name the taste itself.
items.cn: 这个词也开始指味道本身。

note.en: Garlic is compared with look-alike words and other strong kitchen plants.
note.cn: 把 garlic 与形近词以及其他气味浓烈的厨房植物作比较。

to wash the throat with liquid
a round vegetable with a strong taste

normalIntro.en: Garlic is a small bulb that makes its presence known in the kitchen.
normalIntro.cn: garlic 是一种在厨房里存在感很强的小鳞茎。

abstract.en: Garlic teaches that a small thing can fill a whole room.
abstract.cn: 大蒜说明小东西也能充满整个房间。

abstract.en: Strong flavours are remembered longer than mild ones.
abstract.cn: 浓烈的味道比清淡的味道被记得更久。

abstract.en: What we cook with quietly becomes part of us.
abstract.cn: 我们用来烹煮的东西会悄悄成为自己的一部分。

branches.cn: 绿叶从土里长出来。

intro.en: Garlic builds words for its flavour, dishes, and tools.
intro.cn: garlic 构成表示蒜味、菜肴和工具的词。

items.example: The dip is pleasantly garlicky.
items.exampleCN: 这蘸酱有令人愉快的蒜味。

items.example: We ordered garlic bread with the pasta.
items.exampleCN: 我们点意面时配了蒜蓉面包。

items.example: The chicken came with garlic sauce.
Sprinkle garlic powder on the potatoes.

items.meaning: one small section of a garlic bulb
items.example: Crush one clove of garlic.
The garlic press is in the drawer.
They asked for a garlic-free dish.
items.exampleCN: 他们点了一道无蒜的菜。

definition_zh: 气体；燃气；汽油；给（车）加油
definition_en: a substance like air, fuel burned for heat, petrol in American use, or to fill a car with fuel
core_image: 气球被气体撑得鼓起来
scene: 气球里充满了气体。The balloon is full of gas.
sceneCN: 这里 gas 是「气体」（第 1 个义项）；句意：气球里充满了气体。

senses.title: Substance like air
senses.definition: a substance that is not solid or liquid and spreads to fill a space
senses.definitionCN: 既非固体也非液体、会扩散充满空间的物质
senses.example: The balloon is full of gas.
senses.exampleCN: 气球里充满了气体。
senses.why: This is the scientific and general sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是科学和日常通用的义项。

senses.title: Fuel for heat
senses.definition: a flammable gas burned for cooking or heating
senses.definitionCN: 用于烹饪或取暖的可燃气体
senses.example: The gas stove is easy to light.
senses.exampleCN: 这个煤气灶很容易点着。
senses.why: Household fuel is the most common concrete sense.
senses.whyCN: 家用燃料是最常见的具体义项。

senses.title: Petrol
senses.definition: petrol, especially in American English
senses.definitionCN: 汽油，尤用于美式英语
senses.example: We need gas before the next town.
senses.exampleCN: 到下一个镇之前我们得加油。
senses.why: American speech uses gas for motor fuel.
senses.whyCN: 美式口语用 gas 指汽车燃料。

senses.title: Fill with fuel
senses.definition: to fill a vehicle with fuel
senses.definitionCN: 给车辆加满燃料
senses.example: He gassed up the car at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他在加油站给车加了油。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of refuelling.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示加油的动词。

intro.en: Gas was coined by a chemist from a Greek word for empty space.
intro.cn: gas 是化学家根据希腊语中表示虚空的词创造的。

items.en: Khaos described empty space or a gap.
items.cn: khaos 描述虚空或空隙。

items.en: Van Helmont coined gas from that Greek word.
items.cn: 范海尔蒙特根据那个希腊词创造了 gas。

items.en: English adopted gas for vapours and airs.
items.cn: 英语借入 gas 表示蒸汽和气体。

items.en: It widened to coal gas and natural gas.
items.cn: 词义扩展到煤气和天然气。

items.en: American speech made gas a word for petrol.
items.cn: 美式口语使 gas 成为汽油的叫法。

note.en: Gas is compared with look-alike words and other words for air, vapour, and fuel.
note.cn: 把 gas 与形近词以及表示空气、蒸气和燃料的词作比较。

a gas that comes from a liquid or solid
the mixture of gases around the earth

core.en: Invisible matter that spreads to fill space.

senses.title: Door in a wall

senses.why: This is the basic physical sense.

senses.title: Movable barrier

intro.en: Gather is an Old English verb for bringing things into one place.
intro.cn: gather 是古英语动词，意为把东西聚到一处。

branches.en: Usual practice and broad statement meet.
branches.cn: 通常做法与宽泛陈述在此相遇。

branches.en: Wide agreement makes a view general.
branches.cn: 广泛的共识使一种看法变得普遍。

intro.en: Generally builds phrases for broad statements and common agreement.
intro.cn: generally 构成表示宽泛陈述和普遍共识的短语。

latinIntro.en: The root is Latin genus, meaning kind or class.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是拉丁语 genus，意为种类或类别。

items.example: The bus is generally on time.
The general trend is upward.
The answer was a mere generality.
items.exampleCN: 这个回答只是空泛的概括。

items.example: It is risky to generalize from one case.
items.exampleCN: 从一个案例概括是有风险的。

items.example: Generally speaking, the scheme works.
items.exampleCN: 一般来说，这个方案行之有效。

items.example: It is a generally accepted view.
items.exampleCN: 这是一个被普遍接受的观点。

items.example: The story is generally known.
The medicine is generally available.

latinEntries.example: Genus lies behind general and generally.
latinEntries.exampleCN: genus 是 general 和 generally 的词源。

definition_en: to produce energy, to cause something to begin, or to create data or material
core_image: 水坝的水流推动涡轮机发出电来
scene: 大坝发电。The dam generates electricity.
sceneCN: 这里 generate 是「产生；发电」（第 1 个义项）；句意：大坝发电。

senses.title: Produce energy
senses.definition: to produce power, heat, or another form of energy
senses.definitionCN: 产生动力、热量或其他形式的能量
senses.example: The dam generates electricity.
senses.exampleCN: 大坝发电。
senses.why: This is the basic physical sense of producing power.
senses.whyCN: 这是产生动力的基本实体义项。

senses.title: Cause to begin
senses.definition: to cause a feeling, reaction, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 引起某种情绪、反应或状况
senses.example: The news generated a lot of interest.
senses.exampleCN: 这条消息引起了很大兴趣。
senses.why: The word extends from energy to effects.
senses.whyCN: 词义从能量扩展到效果。

senses.title: Create material
senses.definition: to create data, text, or other material by a process
senses.definitionCN: 通过某种过程创建数据、文本或其他材料
senses.example: The program generates a report each week.
senses.exampleCN: 这个程序每周生成一份报告。
senses.why: Machines and software are said to generate output.
senses.whyCN: 机器和软件被说成生成输出。

intro.en: Generate comes from Latin generare, to bring into being.
intro.cn: generate 来自拉丁语 generare，意为使产生。

items.en: Genus meant birth, kind, or family.
items.cn: genus 意为出生、种类或家族。

items.en: Generare meant to beget or produce.
items.cn: generare 意为生育或产生。

items.en: English adopted generate for producing something.
items.cn: 英语借入 generate，表示产生某物。

items.en: Industry gave it the sense of producing power.
items.cn: 工业赋予它产生动力的意思。

items.en: Computing extended it to creating data and text.
items.cn: 计算机领域把它扩展到创建数据和文本。

note.en: Generate is compared with look-alike words and verbs of producing.
note.cn: 把 generate 与形近词以及表示产生的动词作比较。

entries.definition: to give a result or product

normalIntro.en: To generate is to set something into being, whether power, feeling, or data.
normalIntro.cn: generate 就是让某物产生，无论是动力、感受还是数据。

normal.en: The dam generates electricity.
normal.cn: 大坝发电。

normal.en: The news generated a lot of interest.
normal.cn: 这条消息引起了很大兴趣。

normal.en: The program generates a report each week.
normal.cn: 这个程序每周生成一份报告。

normal.en: Friction generates heat.
normal.cn: 摩擦产生热量。

normal.en: The new factory will generate jobs.
normal.cn: 新工厂将创造就业机会。

abstract.en: Every action generates a consequence somewhere.
abstract.cn: 每个行动都会在某处产生后果。

abstract.en: A single idea can generate a whole industry.
abstract.cn: 一个想法可以催生整个产业。

abstract.en: Energy is never made; it only changes form.
abstract.cn: 能量从未被凭空制造，只是改变了形式。

dict_mnemonic.text: generate 与 generation、generator 同根；generate electricity 是「发电」，generate income 是「创造收入」。

root: 拉丁语 generare（生育、产生），源于 genus（出生、种类），核心义「使之产生」。

sensesIntro.en: Generate means to produce energy, to cause a feeling or situation, or to create data and material.
sensesIntro.cn: generate 意为产生能量、引起情绪或状况，或创建数据和材料。

core.en: Bringing something into being.
core.cn: 使某物产生。

branches.en: Water turns a turbine into power.
branches.cn: 水流转动涡轮产生电力。

branches.en: News starts a reaction in people.
branches.cn: 消息在人们中间引发反应。

branches.en: A program makes a fresh report.
branches.cn: 程序生成一份新的报告。

branches.en: Physical power and social effect both begin somewhere.
branches.cn: 物理动力与社会效果都有其起点。

branches.en: Output can be feeling or data.
branches.cn: 产出可以是感受，也可以是数据。

intro.en: Generate builds words for production, machines, and new output.
intro.cn: generate 构成表示产生、机器和新生输出的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root generare means to beget or produce.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语词根 generare 意为生育或产生。

items.example: The panels generate power all day.
The engine generates a lot of heat.
items.exampleCN: 这台发动机产生大量热量。

items.example: The storm generated large waves.

items.meaning: the act of producing or a group born together
items.example: Power generation rose last year.
The generator kept the lights on.
The tool has generative power.
Wind farms generate electricity.
The land generates income for the village.
items.exampleCN: 这片土地为村庄创造收入。

latinEntries.example: Generare is the Latin verb behind generate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: generare 是 generate 背后的拉丁语动词。
